sourcePolicy: Import coordinates from public organizers or mapped roads. Preserve source/year attribution, distinguish partial roads from exact event traces, deduplicate repeated passes, and retain only distinct historical layouts.
limitations: Terrain uses public DEM data, not surveyed jump/rut profiles.
Road widths and scenery are approximate.
Historical labels identify the route source year, not a recreation of every period road detail.
Game championships use distinct sections and repeated passes; no official historical schedule is claimed.
